faq.question: What technologies does Ryan use?
faq.answer: Ryan specializes in the modern React ecosystem. His primary stack includes languages like Python, Java, TypeScript, JavaScript, C, C++, Swift, and SQL. He works with frameworks such as React, Next.js, SwiftUI, Spring Boot, Node.js, Express.js, and FastAPI. For databases, he uses PostgreSQL, Firebase, Supabase, and MongoDB. He also has experience with AI/ML tools including OpenAI API, Gemini API, OpenCV, and MediaPipe.
